system: You are a concise planning assistant. Answer in one short sentence, at most 25 words. Use only the facts in this conversation.
users: Help me plan a small reading group. We have six people, a budget of 90 dollars, and a 60-minute meeting. Ana can attend Tuesday or Thursday. Ben can attend Thursday only. The library room is free on Thursday at 18:00. Coffee costs 3 dollars per person. Which day should we choose?
How much does coffee for everyone cost, and how much budget remains?
Reserve 10 minutes for introductions and 15 minutes for discussion. How many minutes remain for reading?
Summarize the chosen day, start time, number of people, and reading time.
